pages.title: A cold morning · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a snowy morning in the middle of winter in Chicago. Vera wakes up and sees her breath in the air. The apartment is cold like a refrigerator. She checks the heater but it does not move. She puts on two sweaters and a hat. Then she calls the repair service.
“Repair service, Hank speaking. How can I help?” says Hank. “Hi. The heater isn’t working.” says Vera. “I’m sorry to hear that. Since when?” says Hank.
